name: kairu
summary: Single-product course sales page on warm off-white with one hot orange accent, a highlighter-pill headline, faint grid textures and generous 300px section breathing room.

fonts.pairing: medium-weight Cabinet Grotesk headlines with tight -0.04em tracking over Geist body and wide-tracked caps labels

signature: one headline phrase sits inside a soft peach rounded pill like a highlighter swipe
ticker of mock payment notification cards under the hero buttons
macOS-style window chrome framing the trailer video
huge peach numerals on six beige module cards
faint shimmer grid lines behind hero and pricing card
imagery: almost image-free; UI-like notification cards, one framed video still and a single instructor portrait
layout_grid: 1200px frame, 50px side padding, 300px top padding per section, 3-column module grid, 2-column problem and FAQ grids, single centred pricing card about 540px wide
